messages.subject: Change distance of labels to axis
parts:
Maybe a very basic question but...

How can I increase the distance between the axis labels and tick
marks?

win.graph(3.5,3.5)
ggplot(spObs,aes(Observ,Riq))+
geom_boxplot(aes(fill=Periodo),outlier.size=0.5)+
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 7.5,col="grey50"),
axis.title.x=theme_text(size=8),
axis.text.y = theme_text(hjust = 1, size = 7.5,col="grey50"),
axis.title.y=theme_text(size=7.5,angle=90))+
scale_fill_discrete("Períodos de\n5 minutos",labels=c
("1º","2º","3º"))

By doing this I get the x labels "glued" to axis tickmarks.
